page.notes: The page is a printed index in italic type. The running title "INDEX" is set in spaced capitals at the top; the page number is not printed. The column tops and bottoms are partly faded; the first line of the right column and the last line of the left column are doubtful. The bottom of the page shows the start of a catchword cut off by the edge, unreadable, and it is left out. "[?]" marks the last word of "Menses si apud omnes idem essent:", where the scan is faded. Also doubtful: "no" in "Medico no est" and "no ex sideram" (likely non ex siderum), which I copied as printed; "Hip." and "arteri" in the right column; the number "193" and "ibid." readings. The "Digitized by Google" watermark and the scan edges are excluded.
